name: Tic Tac Toe XO: Strategy Games
summary: a Tic Tac Toe and Drop Four strategy game
features: **Offline play:** Matches against the on-device AI, or against a friend on the same device, work without an internet connection.
**Local stats & replays:** Match history, statistics and replays are stored on your device.
storage: **Stats, match history & settings:** Stored on your device with on-device preferences. Clear them with **Reset statistics** in Settings, or by clearing the app's storage in Android settings.

name: NickCraft: Nickname Generator
summary: a nickname generator and fancy text styler
features: **On-device text styling:** Font conversion, decorations, symbols and random nickname generation run entirely on your device. What you type is never uploaded.
**Works offline:** All fonts, decorations and symbols ship inside the app.
**Copy & share:** Copying writes to your clipboard and sharing uses the Android share sheet, only when you tap them. We do not read your clipboard.
storage: **Favourites, history & settings:** Saved on your device with on-device preferences. Delete them in the app, or clear the app's storage in Android settings.

name: ScanCraft: QR & Barcode Scanner
summary: a QR code and barcode scanner and generator
features: **On-device scanning:** The camera preview is analysed in real time by Google ML Kit's on-device barcode model. Camera frames are never stored or uploaded.
**Scan from an image:** You can pick an image with the Android picker; it is decoded on your device and not uploaded.
**Code generator:** Create QR codes and barcodes (links, Wi-Fi, contacts, text, locations and more). Images are saved only when you tap Save or Share.
**Scan history:** Results are kept in a local database on your device so you can find them again.
**Optional product lookup:** When the setting is on and you scan a product barcode, only the barcode number is sent to the open Open Food Facts database to show the product name.

permissions.name: Camera
permissions.use: Required to scan codes. Requested the first time you open the scanner; frames are processed on the device only.

permissions.name: Location
permissions.use: Only used when you tap **Use My Current GPS Position** in the generator to put coordinates into a location QR code. Your location is never collected, stored or shared by us.

storage: **Scan & creation history:** Stored in a private on-device database. Delete single items, clear the history in Settings, or turn history off.
**Settings:** Theme, sound, vibration and scanner preferences are stored with on-device preferences.
**Saved images:** Codes you save are written to your device's Documents folder and are under your control.

services.name: Google ML Kit Barcode Scanning (Google LLC)
services.use: On-device model that decodes barcodes. No images are sent to Google for scanning.

services.name: Open Food Facts (optional)
services.use: Receives only the barcode number of a scanned product when Product Lookup is on.

dataSafety: **Precise location:** Not collected. It is read on the device only when you request it for a location QR code and is never sent by us.
**Photos & camera:** Not collected. Camera frames and picked images are processed on the device only.

name: RepeatIt: Text Repeater
summary: a text repeater and fancy text styler
features: **On-device text processing:** Repeating text, separators, numbering, emoji and Unicode font styles are computed entirely on your device. Your text is never uploaded.
**Templates & styles:** Built-in templates and font styles ship inside the app.
**Copy, share & save:** Results are copied to your clipboard, shared through the Android share sheet, or saved as a .txt file only when you choose to.
**History & favourites:** Recent results are kept on your device.
storage: **History, favourites & settings:** Stored on your device with on-device preferences. Clear them in the app, or via **Settings > Apps > RepeatIt > Storage > Clear data**.
**Saved text files:** Written to your device's Documents folder only when you tap Save.

name: TaskFlow: To-Do List & Planner
summary: a to-do list, planner and reminder app
features: **Local-first tasks:** Tasks, subtasks, notes, categories, due dates and repeat rules are stored only on your device.
**Reminders:** Reminder notifications are scheduled locally by Android; no server is involved.
**Backup & restore:** You can export a backup file and import it again. The file goes wherever you choose; we never receive it.

permissions.name: Notifications
permissions.use: Shows the task reminders you set.

permissions.name: Exact Alarms
permissions.use: Delivers reminders at the exact time you chose. Android may open the "Alarms & reminders" screen so you can allow this.

permissions.name: Run at Startup
permissions.use: Restores your scheduled reminders after the device restarts.

storage: **Tasks, categories & settings:** Stored on your device with on-device preferences. Delete individual tasks, empty the Trash, use **Reset App Data** in Settings, or clear the app's storage in Android settings.
**Backups:** Backup files you export are stored wherever you save or share them.
